infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is required to record video for GPS frame tagging.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required to record audio with your video.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is required to tag each video frame with GPS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Location access is required to continuously tag video frames with GPS coordinates, even when the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bluetooth is used to discover and pair with GoPro and other external cameras.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Local network access is used to control connected cameras over Wi-Fi.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to connect to Bluetooth cameras.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to join camera Wi-Fi networks.
